title: The push-forward of a cycle is a cycle (Simon 6.2.24(1))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n) representing X ∈ 𝒟_n(U), K ⊆ U compact with Hⁿ(M ∖ K) = 0 (Hⁿ = μHE[n]), O ⊆ ℝ^P open with K ⊆ O, and f : ℝ^P → ℝ^P of class C¹ on O. Let Q ∈ 𝒟_n(U) satisfy Q(ω) = ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(f(x))∘Df(x)) dHⁿ(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) (Df(x) = fderiv ℝ f x, ω(f(x))∘Df(x) := (ω (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)). If ∂X = 0 in U (BoundaryVanishes X; vacuous for n = 0), then ∂Q = 0 in U (BoundaryVanishes Q).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U K O : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P) (X Q : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (R.carrier \ K) = 0 → IsOpen O → K ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O → R.Represents X → BoundaryVanishes X → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Q ω = ∫ x in R.carrier, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x (((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) ∂μHE[n]) → BoundaryVanishes Q
